name: @local/gitlab-mcp
description: Inspect GitLab projects, triage merge requests and issues, debug CI/CD, address review feedback, and publish changes.

scripts.lint: eslint server/src server/test test test-dependency-boundaries scripts shared adapters .dependency-cruiser.mjs .dependency-cruiser-rules.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write "*.md" package.json package-lock.json distribution.json benchmarks .gitlab-ci.yml eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .dependency-cruiser.mjs .dependency-cruiser-rules.mjs server/src server/test test test-dependency-boundaries scripts shared adapters docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "*.md" package.json package-lock.json distribution.json benchmarks .gitlab-ci.yml eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .dependency-cruiser.mjs .dependency-cruiser-rules.mjs server/src server/test test test-dependency-boundaries scripts shared adapters docs
scripts.deps:check: depcruise server/src scripts skills shared adapters
scripts.release:validate: npm run adapters:check && npm run validate:harnesses && npm run validate:release-set
scripts.validate:harnesses: npm run validate:codex && npm run validate:claude && npm run validate:cline && npm run validate:pi
